source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30, 1x1 deg tile N51 E107 (2400x3600 px, 1.5 x 1 arcsec), file glo30_N51_E107.tif

near.resampling: cubic spline from ~30 m native; spacing 7.03 m (interpolated, not extra detail)

layout: Float32 little-endian, row-major; row 0 = z=-half (north), col 0 = x=-half (west); x=(lon-centerLon)*metersPerDegLon, z=-(lat-centerLat)*metersPerDegLat; metres above EGM2008 geoid
